description: Defines a Polymer behavior for a custom element with a 'checked' property, including validation and toggling features, used in forms.

classes.name: Polymer.IronCheckedElementBehaviorImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a behavior with 'checked' property, validation, and state toggling.

methods.name: _checkedChanged
methods.description: Updates 'active' state and 'value' when 'checked' changes; fires 'iron-change' event.

methods.name: _requiredChanged
methods.description: Sets or removes 'aria-required' attribute based on 'required' property.

methods.name: _getValidity
methods.description: Returns validity status based on 'required', 'checked', and 'disabled' properties.
